summary: Quiet residential bend; homes within 25m all round, no parking convention.
reasons: Flat at the bend, steep either side

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 11 to 21 m away on the north side, more across the road; dense hedges screen some.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with kerbside room; a few cars park nearby.
drivers.traffic: Local residential street, little through traffic.
drivers.convention: No sign of campers; kerb parking is only occasional.

flags: Steep either side of the bend: up to 12.6% max, 6.6% mean over the stretch
sun_shade: Hedges and trees shade the north side; open to midday sun from the north.

best_section.where: At the bend on Nindethana Street, outside the hedged house
